metadata.name: AI Ecosystem Scanner - Feed Config
metadata.author: Kyle / The Prompt
metadata.purpose: n8n RSS automation - Ecosystem Scanner workflow
metadata.notes: Claude API relevance scoring (threshold >= 7) should reduce to ~15-25 items/day

tier1_primary_sources.description: Direct from the companies building AI. Highest signal, lowest noise.

feeds.name: Anthropic News
feeds.why: Your primary platform. Product launches, safety research, MCP updates.

feeds.name: Anthropic Engineering
feeds.why: Technical deep dives. Infrastructure patterns you can reference in consulting.

feeds.name: OpenAI Blog
feeds.why: GPT releases, API changes, product strategy. Competitive intel for newsletter.

feeds.name: Google AI Blog
feeds.why: Gemini updates, Workspace AI features, research breakthroughs.

feeds.name: Microsoft AI Blog
feeds.why: Copilot ecosystem, Azure AI, enterprise AI strategy.

tier2_industry_news.description: Curated tech journalism. Ecosystem-level signals and analysis.

feeds.name: TechCrunch AI
feeds.why: Funding rounds, product launches, startup ecosystem. High volume — needs filtering.

feeds.name: The Verge AI
feeds.why: Consumer AI coverage, policy, platform moves. Good for non-technical newsletter tier.

feeds.name: VentureBeat AI
feeds.why: Enterprise AI focus. Best source for B2B AI trends relevant to consulting positioning.

feeds.name: Ars Technica
feeds.why: Deep technical analysis. Security and infrastructure coverage is excellent. Broad — filter to AI/security tags.

feeds.name: Techmeme
feeds.why: Aggregator of aggregators. If something matters, it shows up here. Good pulse check.

feeds.name: Wired AI
feeds.why: Longer-form AI analysis. Good for newsletter think-pieces.

tier3_developer_ecosystem.description: Builder-focused sources. What developers and founders are actually using.

feeds.name: Hacker News Front Page
feeds.why: Developer zeitgeist. Highest signal for what builders care about RIGHT NOW. Very high volume — Claude filter essential.

feeds.name: Hacker News - AI/ML filtered
feeds.why: Pre-filtered HN for AI-specific discussions. Lower noise than full front page.

feeds.name: Product Hunt
feeds.why: New AI product launches. Competitive intelligence for what's shipping.

feeds.name: Cursor Blog
feeds.why: AI IDE ecosystem. Relevant to builder audience and consulting clients.

feeds.name: Vercel Blog
feeds.why: Your deployment platform. AI SDK updates, Next.js changes, infrastructure patterns.

feeds.name: Supabase Blog
feeds.why: Your database platform. Auth, RLS, edge functions, pgvector updates.

tier4_research_and_safety.description: Deeper research and AI safety signals. Lower volume, higher insight density.

feeds.name: ArXiv CS.AI (recent)
feeds.why: Academic AI research. EXTREMELY high volume. Only useful with aggressive Claude filtering for breakthrough papers. Consider weekly batch instead of daily.

feeds.name: Ahead of AI (Sebastian Raschka)
feeds.why: Best ML research newsletter. Distills academic papers into practitioner insights. High signal.

feeds.name: The Algorithmic Bridge
feeds.why: AI analysis bridging technical and societal implications. Good newsletter content source.

tier5_security_and_infrastructure.description: AppSec and infrastructure signals. Feeds your security-first positioning.

feeds.name: The Hacker News (cybersecurity)
feeds.why: Security news. AI-related vulnerabilities, supply chain attacks, auth bypasses. Relevant to AppSec consulting angle.

feeds.name: Krebs on Security
feeds.why: Deep security investigations. Low volume, high impact. Good for security-angle newsletter content.

feeds.name: Cloudflare Blog
feeds.why: Edge computing, Workers AI, security infrastructure. Your CDN/edge platform.

feeds.name: Simon Willison's Weblog
feeds.why: Best individual blogger covering practical AI tooling. LLM workflows, prompt engineering, tool building. Extremely high signal-to-noise.

n8n_config_notes.claude_filter_prompt: Rate this article 1-10 for relevance to an AI ecosystem intelligence newsletter focused on: AI platform moves, developer tooling, MCP/agent infrastructure, enterprise AI adoption, and AI security. Only score >= 7 if it contains actionable builder intelligence, not just product announcements or hype. Return JSON: {score: number, reason: string, category: string, newsletter_angle: string}
